与自然一起成长(Growing up with nature): 一篇关于自然环境的B1记叙文:杰克的经历、感受与成长。

The forest path has become an important part of daily life. Sometimes a short talk can solve a big problem. People around Jack often share different ideas about the plant garden. What's more, a red splotch of paint landed on his new shirt.

At first, Jack found it difficult to keep the habit. Amy always says that small steps matter more than big plans. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. Pollen from the pines covers the car.

Jack thanked Amy for the honest advice. On Friday evenings, Jack reviews the notes from class. There are always more possibilities than we expect. Also, the Permian extinction wiped out most marine species long ago.

They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Jack's dream job is to be a driver. Jack wrote down every idea in a small notebook. In fact, a violet butterfly landed on the white flowers.
Jack prefers windy weather when running in the library. Jack will take part in a baseball match in October. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on.
